span.p:
3 · enter(q′): cancel timer, entry behaviour
PATROL: walk route · ALERT: stop, arm 700 ms
CHASE: re-path · SEARCH: go to last known position
CAPTURE: stop

GuardMover speed 40/0/70/50/0 px/s, BFS path,
facing · GuardView icon and cone
